CheckTitle: SMN topics have at least one subscription configured
Description: Ensure that SMN notification topics have at least one subscription so alerts are delivered to recipients.
Risk: Topics without subscriptions will not deliver notifications, meaning critical alerts may go unnoticed by operations and security teams.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Simple Message Notification (SMN).
3. Select the topic without subscriptions.
4. Click Add Subscription.
5. Configure the subscription protocol and endpoint.
6. Confirm the subscription.

Recommendation.Text: Add at least one subscription to each SMN topic to ensure notifications are delivered.

Notes: Checks if SMN topics have at least one subscription. Topics with zero subscriptions fail because notifications won't be delivered.
